issue.title: toobig splits must keep just _lint-symvision green; agents must compare masked stages when it is red
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** toobig split routine prompt (chezmoi-managed SASE config, outside this repo) + agent symvision triage behavior

A `toobig` routine split breaking symvision with cross-module privates has now happened six times (sase-13l, sase-10n, sase-zk, sase-17c, sase-17j, sase-17l). Each split moved `_`-prefixed helpers into sibling modules and imported them across files; symvision matches private names by name, so one split reddens stage 1 for the whole repo. A red stage 1 then hides stages 2 and 3, so in-progress epics land new unused symbols unseen for a day (this round: ~30 hidden symbols behind the three splits).

Repro: land any toobig split that imports a `_`-private across files, then run `just _lint-symvision` — stage 1 fails and stages 2/3 never print. Reveal them with the masked-stage probe from plan:202609/symvision_green_master.md Step 0.

Impact: every agent's `just check` stops before the test lane until someone does the full green-master sweep; epic regressions accumulate behind the red stage.
